items.title: Архив на фотографиите
paragraphs: Оригиналната българска Gmedia страница няма публикувани отделни записи. Тук са представени запазените публични концертни фотографии от оригиналния архив.

items.title: Gmedia Albums Archive
paragraphs: The original publicly listed WordPress gallery albums.

items.title: Concert on 23.03.2016
paragraphs: Original WordPress album title: Concert on 23.03.2016. Its date conflicts with the orchestra history, which records the concert at Studio 5 on 13 March 2016. The discrepancy in original metadata is retained for verification.

items.title: Contemporary Bulgaran Composers in 432 Hz
paragraphs: Photographs preserved from the original WordPress album. The album title is retained as published.

items.title: Concert 148 Years Bulgarian Academy of Sciences
paragraphs: The album was publicly listed in WordPress, but contained no registered photographs in the recovered Gmedia album data. The album title is retained without inventing images.
